# Paolo Camerin

> Designer, digital artist, and creative technologist based in Oslo.

Paolo Camerin (online: g3n0m4) works at the intersection of product design, interaction design, and digital art. His work spans UX/UI for commercial products, generative art, and creative coding using tools like TouchDesigner.

## Work

- [Portfolio — Design](https://g3n0m4.xyz/): Selected product design case studies
- [Bilista case study](https://g3n0m4.xyz/projects/bilista.html): Norway's first holistic car ownership platform, built for Gjensidige Mobility Group at EGGS Design in Oslo (2022–2023). Full-cycle UX/UI: research, prototyping, testing, component library, and design system.

## Tutorials & Creative Work

- [Holographic card — TouchDesigner tutorial](https://g3n0m4.xyz/tutorials/06-holographic-card/): Free assets and walkthrough for creating a holographic trading-card effect in TouchDesigner.
- Art section on the portfolio features generative video work (baroque, paint, and abstract motion pieces).

## About this site

g3n0m4.xyz is a personal portfolio and creative outlet. Content is in English. The site is updated periodically with new projects and tutorials.
